# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/events_crown.mjs, docs/design/stage2/events_crown.md). Do not edit.
# Monthly checks of the endings' lead-up (convention C6). Called by zin_story_tick.
zin_story_tick_ending = {
	# zin_ending.1 and .2: one and two years before the judgement date, to every human player while no ending is reached.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_story_done_ending_1 }
			zin_ending_date_lead_1 = yes
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_story_done_ending_1
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_ending_reached }
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = no
				}
				country_event = zin_ending.1
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_story_done_ending_2 }
			zin_ending_date_lead_2 = yes
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_story_done_ending_2
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_ending_reached }
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = no
				}
				country_event = zin_ending.2
			}
		}
	}
	# zin_ending.3: Volgan's readiness at two monthly checks in a row (the first sets zin_ending_volgan_near), before the date from which the world module reaches the ending at once.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_ending_reached }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_story_done_ending_3 }
			NOT = { zin_world_date_children = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					zin_is_volgan = yes
					zin_volgan_children_ready = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = zin_ending_volgan_near
				}
				set_global_flag = zin_story_done_ending_3
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						is_ai = no
						has_war_with = PUV
					}
					country_event = zin_ending.3
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_global_flag = zin_ending_volgan_near
			}
		}
		else = {
			clr_global_flag = zin_ending_volgan_near
		}
	}
	# zin_ending.4: the name is out, Afrit holds Parim, twelve crowns owe him a hearing, and the Ashen Throne is not yet ready.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_ending_reached }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_story_done_ending_4 }
			has_global_flag = zin_afrit_revealed
			zin_afrit_holds_parim = yes
			NOT = {
				zin_afrit_ashen_throne_ready = yes
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_t_deep = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = zin_footholds value = 4 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_t_deep = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_t_deep > 11 }
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_story_done_ending_4
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = no
					any_enemy_country = {
						zin_afrit_rules_here = yes
					}
				}
				country_event = zin_ending.4
			}
		}
	}
	# The Chronicle says whether the great war began early or late; it is told the first month the flag is seen.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_ending_cp11_known }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_ending_cp11_known
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					zin_world_date_last_crowns = yes
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_ending_cp11_early
		}
		else = {
			set_global_flag = zin_ending_cp11_late
		}
	}
}
